title: Attack to force the project into the exodusMode
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, disabled core project functions forever  **Likelihood:** High, easy to execute by anyone  ## Description  The attack flow:  1. Deposit ETH from a malicious smart contract A, which reverts when receiving ETH 2. Await for the deposit settlement to Nume network 3. call `submitWithdrawalRequest()` 4. the owner has 14 days to withdraw via `notarizeSettlement()` 5. the owner tries to settle the withdrawal but it fails - a malicious smart contract A intentionally reverts not receiving ETH 6. The attacker waits 14 days 7. The attacker calls `challengeUserWithdrawal()` =>
